request: Imagine the black handle is a stand. Add another one on the other side of device in approximately same distane from side wall as the existing one. Remove the Cordholder. Cut the bottom of the handles so it allows the device to be stable on a flat surface.

actions.operation: Create another handle based on the existing black handle.

parameters.offset: approximately the same distance from the side wall as the existing handle

actions.target: the existing black handle and the other side of the device
actions.relational_constraint: Place the new handle on the opposite side of the device, at approximately the same side-wall distance as the existing handle.
actions.unresolved_reference: Identify the existing black handle, the corresponding opposite side of the device, the applicable side wall, and the existing handle-to-side-wall distance.
Identify the feature or body named or functioning as the Cordholder.

actions.operation: Cut or trim the bottom of both handles.
actions.target: the bottoms of the existing handle and the newly added handle
actions.relational_constraint: The resulting handle bottoms must allow the device to rest stably on a flat surface.
actions.unresolved_reference: Identify both handles, their bottom regions, the required cut extent, and the flat support plane needed for stable placement.

intention: Use the black handle and its added counterpart as stands.
Allow the device to rest stably on a flat surface.
